jobs.description: Natera is seeking a highly motivated Staff Machine Learning Scientist to join our rapidly growing company. As a member of the Data Science research team you will participate in the design and prototyping of cutting edge algorithms for analysis of genetic and clinical data. You will perform data analysis, algorithm design, contribute to our intellectual property portfolio, and interact closely with R&D and product teams to define the requirements and improve the products and processes. PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES: ML/DL Research Leadership: Lead research on machine learning and deep learning models using NGS data. Frame the problem, choose the approach, and decide when a model has earned the next round of investment. This is an individual contributor role with Staff-level scope. You will set the technical direction of the work, not just carry out a plan someone else wrote. Algorithm and Model Development: Design, build, and benchmark the models and features behind the next generation of Women Health and Organ Health products. Apply statistical learning and deep learning to high-dimensional, noisy, often small-sample sequencing data. Know when a simpler method is the right answer. Working with Bioinformatics Pipelines: Work directly with the existing sequencing pipelines and their outputs without needing a bioinformatician to run, change, or interpret them for you. When results look wrong, trace the problem back through each processing step and work out whether it comes from the pipeline, the data, or the biology. Build or extend pipeline components when a project needs it.Â Study Design and Experimental Partnership: Work with molecular biology and assay development scientists to design experiments. Help decide what data to generate, how much of it, and with what controls so the analysis can answer the question. Troubleshoot experiments alongside the lab, and tell a biology problem from a data or analysis problem. Rigor and Documentation: Set the standard for careful analysis on the team: sound validation design, honest performance estimates, no leakage between training and evaluation data, and documentation. Support the group in producing high-quality technical and design documentation. Intellectual Property and Scientific Contribution: Contribute to Natera's IP portfolio through invention disclosures and patent work, and to its scientific reputation through publications and presentations where appropriate. Technical Leadership and Mentorship: Mentor data scientists and bioinformaticians, review their work, and be the person others bring hard modeling questions to. Make decisions about your own methods with minimal direction, including when the problem is ambiguous, and know when to escalate. Ways of Working: AI is a routine part of the work here, including coding agents for implementation, analysis, and review. You own what you ship, whatever produced it. We do not screen for prior experience with these tools, and we provide the tooling and the ramp time. QUALIFICATIONS: M.S. or Ph.D. in a quantitative field such as Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Engineering, or similar. Equivalent depth built through work counts fully. 6+ years of hands-on experience in machine learning and data analysis on biological or genomic data after your degree. We count relevant experience from the point your work became substantially independent, however you got there. A demonstrated track record of models or algorithms you led that reached real use (a product, a production pipeline, or a decision someone relied on), not only a result. We are hiring for depth in NGS, bioinformatics, and machine learning, and we will provide the domain ramp. KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES: Depth in next-generation sequencing data analysis: sequencing QC, alignment and quantification, normalization, and the artifacts that come with them. You should have the judgment to spot a wrong result before someone else

jobs.title: Founding Account Executive – Poland
jobs.description: About Tacto Tacto builds Industrial AI for procurement in manufacturing. Built for industrial complexity, designed to optimize every procurement decision. Over 50% of a product’s cost originates from suppliers, making procurement the single largest cost lever in manufacturing and the missing connection between the digital and the physical world. 400+ procurement organizations work with Tacto ~110 people on the team in Munich €50M+ raised, led by Sequoia and Index Ventures, with Cherry Ventures, UVC Partners and others Our mission at Tacto We make industry stronger. Manufacturing is the backbone of the European economy, and supply chains are its biggest challenge. Yet procurement in many companies still runs on Excel and legacy systems. With AI, we are fundamentally changing how manufacturers buy: measurably lower material costs and far less manual work. Your role You open Poland for Tacto and win the first customers that everything else builds on. Why this role exists Tacto is the category leader for procurement in DACH manufacturing. We have strong product-market fit and a proven playbook, and now we are taking it into the rest of Europe. Poland is one of our expansion markets. It has become one of Europe’s major manufacturing hubs, and the category is still wide open there. That’s where you come in: you take the market and build it from the ground up. You research the market, find what resonates and win the first customers and reference logos. What you learn becomes the blueprint for how Tacto grows in Poland from there. Why your role matters A real greenfield. You have the freedom to shape how Tacto wins in your market, from the ICP to the first reference logos. You’re not starting alone. A stellar expansion team is your sparring partner, and proven sales assets and a tested approach from DACH are your foundation. You write the blueprint. What works in your first deals becomes the playbook for everyone who follows you in Poland. You shape how Tacto goes international. Your insights go straight to Product, Marketing and Leadership. What this role is and isn’t Hands on: You send the first cold emails, run the first discoveries and do the early, unglamorous work where real traction is won. Not a managed territory: There is no machine behind you yet. You drive your own pipeline and build the motion as you go. Not a remote role: You build Poland from our Munich office and travel into the market. Your tasks Open up Poland end to end: You sharpen the ICP for Polish manufacturing, define target accounts, win the first deals and lay the foundation for the market’s growth. Run the full sales cycle: Discovery, demo, potential analysis on real ERP data, ROI business case and closing. Build the outbound playbook: Hand in hand with the expansion team, you develop messaging, sequences, segments and channels for your market. Turn marketing into pipeline: You coordinate the marketing activities in your market so they generate pipeline. Shape our international expansion: You feed structured insight back to Product, Marketing and Leadership. Your profile Experience and skills Experience: Several years of full-cycle closing experience in B2B SaaS, ideally with complex or technical products and multi-stakeholder buying processes Track record: You’ve carried a number before and know what it takes to hit it without a machine behind you Value selling: You grasp complex products and translate technical depth into business impact Languages: Fluent, business-level English. Polish is a strong plus. We hire for mindset and ability, not origin or native language Location: Based in Munich or ready to relocate Core strengths Entrepreneurial: You want to build and own a market result, and figure out the motion when the local one doesn’t exist yet Hunter: You go to market proactively and drive your own pipeline Builder: You turn what works into a system the next person can run Thinks beyond the next deal: You lay Tacto’s foundation in your market, externall

jobs.description: About Focused Energy Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A — the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry — we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies. Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally. Your Role Focused Energy seeks a Working Student - Laser Lab & Cleanroom Operations (f/m/d) for our Laser Lab in Darmstadt to support laser experiment design and setup. You will assist with cleanroom operations, including preparing and inspecting optical components, setting up support systems, electronics, and measurement equipment, and helping commission cooling and driver units. After setup, you will operate experiments and collect data. This immersive, hands-on role involves daily collaboration with lab and controls engineers in a cleanroom, requiring precision, adherence to What You'll Do Assist the Laser Lab team in designing and building laser experiments in the Darmstadt Optical Lab. Support cleanroom operations by setting up support systems and preparing components. Clean and inspect optical and mechanical components according to cleanroom standards. Set up electronics and measurement equipment for experiments. Collaborate with engineers to commission cooling and driver units. Operate experiments and collect data under engineering supervision. Who You Are Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Physics, Optics/Photonics, Laser Engineering, Mechatronics, Electrical Engineering , or a related field. You possess a basic understanding of optics, lasers, or experimental physics through coursework or laboratory experience. Comfortable with hands-on hardware work, demonstrating careful, precise, and methodical handling of sensitive components. Able to reliably follow structured procedures and safety protocols (such as cleanroom or laboratory guidelines). Basic familiarity with electronics and measurement equipment, such as oscilloscopes, power meters, or similar devices. You demonstrate reliability, a structured and proactive approach, and a willingness to learn in a hands-on laboratory environment. Strong English skills. What We Offer Innovative Technology & Mission: Be part of a cutting-edge company working on groundbreaking research in clean energy and scientific discovery. Career Development: We invest in our people. This is an opportunity to join an early, growing company at the forefront of new technology, where you’ll have the opportunity to develop and grow your career. Collaborative Culture: Work with great people in a dynamic, international environment with top-tier scientists, engineers and professionals passionate about solving global challenges. Ownership: Take ownership from day 1 and drive impact by making decisions, solving challenges and shaping the future of our company. Your Success is our Success: We offer a competitive salary and company ownership in the form of stock options, giving you a direct stake in our success and ownership in what we build together. Vacation Days: We support your work-life-balance by granting you 30 days of vacation per year. Snacks and Drinks: Our office fridges are never empty. Enjoy our healthy snacks and drinks. jobs.title: 3D Environment Artist & Level Designer
jobs.description: 3D Environment Artist & Level Designer ScapeWorld Entertainment · Remote Level: Senior to lead Location: Remote, CET overlap Contract: Full time, long term About us We are ScapeWorld Entertainment, a fully remote Swedish game studio of just over 20 people. We are building Scape, a platform of multiplayer games where a player’s identity carries across all of them. We have just launched our first game within Scape. Our senior team has shipped and run live games at studios including Arrowhead (Helldivers 2), Avalanche Studios and Ubisoft. The project Our next game is a cleaning and restoration sim set in a shared neighbourhood. Every player has a place of their own that starts buried in junk and grime, and puts it in order in full view of neighbours who are doing the same. Cleaning games are usually played alone or in short co-op sessions. We want to make one set in a neighbourhood that players share and keep coming back to, and we want to do it well. We have a working prototype and are refining the loop now. If you play games like this and have views on what makes them satisfying, you will enjoy this. About the role We are looking for a senior to lead 3D environment artist who is also a level designer. You will be the only level designer on the project. You own the game’s spaces, from first layout through to dressed and lit, and you are responsible for delivering them. The role is split roughly evenly between environment art, mostly props and other environment 3D assets, and level design, which includes some gameplay design. On the design side you work with our Creative Director and engineering, and you bring your level and gameplay design experience into those discussions. On the art side you work with the rest of the art team. You report to the Art Director. What you will do Environment art Model and texture props and other environment 3D assets. Most of what we use is made in-house, and we also work with asset packs where they fit. Work to our polygon, texture and material standards. Assets used in large numbers, such as foliage, are kept low poly. Most props use standard poly counts. Build modular kits that can be reused across levels. Dress and light levels in Unity, following the Art Director’s visual direction. Level design Design the layout of rooms and plots: how the player moves through them, what they notice first, and the order in which the space is revealed as it is cleared. Greybox levels and take them through to final, checking scale, pathing and collision in engine. Test levels in engine and in playtests, and make changes based on the results. Help shape how spaces support the game loop and its features, and give input on pacing and progression. Document your work: layout plans, kit guides and dressing guidelines. What we are looking for Senior to lead level, with several years of professional experience in game development. Experience as both an environment artist and a level designer. You have done each on at least one project, shipped or not, and you have owned a game’s spaces or levels from start to finish. Some gameplay design experience, for example working on game loops, features or mechanics alongside level layouts. A portfolio that shows both sides: real-time environments and 3D assets you made, and levels you designed, from greybox to final. Good working knowledge of Unity, including building and lighting levels. Our level tools are built inside Unity. Comfortable using Blender. It is part of our production pipeline, and we have built an add-on for it. Comfortable using the Substance suite for texturing and materials. Comfortable giving your view in design discussions and explaining your reasoning. Able to work independently from a brief, and to work closely with a small team. Comfortable working in English every day, in meetings (mostly on camera) and in writing. It does not need to be perfect. Nice to have 3D character or gameplay animation. 3D character modelling. Technical art or VFX. Experience

jobs.description: Build a Safer World. TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure. About TRM TRM Labs is on a mission to build a safer world by fighting crime and protecting the people who investigate it. We started as a blockchain intelligence company, helping law enforcement, government agencies, financial institutions, and businesses detect, investigate, and disrupt crypto-enabled crime. Today our platform reaches well beyond the blockchain: we fuse on-chain data with cyber and open-source intelligence (OSINT) so investigators can move from a single crypto address to the full story behind a criminal network. Our blockchain intelligence and AI intelligence platforms turn fragmented signals into fast, defensible investigative leads for the teams protecting public safety and national security every day. TRM Academy delivers training and certification for the global community of investigators, analysts, and compliance professionals who detect and prevent fraud and financial crime involving cryptocurrencies. Learners get live and virtual courses, practical exercises, and a community of the world's experts in blockchain, crypto compliance, and financial crime investigations. About the Role As the Lead Instructor, EMEA , you will own the design and delivery of TRM Academy training across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa, with blockchain intelligence and crypto investigations at the core of what you teach. You will turn complex on-chain concepts into practical, mission-ready skills for law enforcement, national security, and government audiences, and you will be equally comfortable teaching crypto businesses, exchanges, and financial institutions. Cyber and OSINT tradecraft is the complement: you will show investigators how to pair it with on-chain tracing to build a complete case. EMEA is a region where we win by showing up. You will deliver in person, in the room, with customers across the UK, DACH, the Nordics and Baltics, France, and beyond, and you will work closely with our regional sales, value engineering, and customer success teams so that training drives adoption and opens the next conversation. You will join a Training Team of master instructors who can command a room, build engaging content, and speak to every level of expertise. We know how our products are used in the real world and help our customers become humble masters too. This is also a build role. EMEA training is a growing opportunity, and you will help shape how it is scoped, packaged, and delivered as the region scales. Please note: this role requires travel of 50-75%, primarily across EMEA. The Impact You'll Have Here Program manage and deliver live, in-person, and virtual blockchain intelligence training to law enforcement, national security, and government learners across EMEA. Teach crypto fundamentals through advanced investigations on TRM's blockchain intelligence and AI intelligence platforms, helping investigators trace funds and build complete, defensible cases. Adapt content for regional legal frameworks, case types, and audience maturity, from first-time crypto investigators to experienced national security analysts. Pair on-chain tracing with cyber and OSINT techniques in courses and case walkthroughs, so learners can pivot from off-chain signals to blockchain activity. Powered by our own AI models, Fin resolves complex customer issues end-to-end across every channel, with minimal set-up and integration. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk, giving modern support teams one single system.</p> <p>Together with Salesforce, the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success, we're building the future of customer experience. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword, it's a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing, and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI.</p> <p>Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.</p></div><h2>What's the opportunity?&nbsp;</h2> <p>We’re looking for Staff Product Engineers to join the AI Group to build Fin's AI-powered products. Product Engineers working in ML work closely with both our ML Scientists and product teams. They must deeply understand our product, our customers, our ML tech stack and our broader product stack.&nbsp;</p> <p>Our group is responsible for defining new ML features, researching appropriate algorithms and technologies, and rapidly getting first prototypes in our customers’ hands.</p> <p>We are an extremely product focussed team. jobs.title: Product Analytics Team Lead
jobs.description: HEY THERE You've spent the last few years as the analyst sitting alongside a mobile squad—close to the tracking, the experiments and the numbers behind their decisions. You've also been leading a small team as well for a while now, and you don't want to give up either half. Good, because this role doesn't ask you to. You'll lead our squad analysts, and you'll also be the hands-on analyst for Monetization. Roughly half your week in each role, at least at the start. Stepping up to lead here doesn't mean handing the interesting work to someone else. You'll be building solid data products, helping our Monetization team optimize conversion and revenue, but you'll also be responsible for ensuring that our product and engineering teams own the quality of the data they produce. Building this culture is a big part of what we're hiring for. Let's shape the future of nutrition together and make Yazio the most successful nutrition app worldwide! This role is 100% remote and open to candidates based in Germany, Spain, Portugal or the UK. YOUR MISSION Our product generates billions of data points every month, and our development teams run hundreds of experiments a year. In your first year, you'll: Lead a small team of analysts embedded in our product squads. They're the ones measuring the impact of what engineering builds and helping figure out what comes next Be the analyst for Monetization yourself. You’ll handle tracking for new features, the experiments behind our conversion funnels and the reporting the squad runs on Set the example for how the work gets done. You'll write less production code than the analysts in your team, and the way you solve problems is what they'll pick up Set the data quality bar: what gets tested when data comes in, what gets tested once it's transformed, what gets tested in the reporting layer and what anomaly detection catches before a stakeholder spots it Move that responsibility upstream to the teams producing the data. Expect pushback from people who haven't had to think about it before Own the path from raw event data to curated, ready-to-use datasets in our self-service BI tool Take on the strategy side of squad analytics: how PMs and engineering managers use data when they make decisions YOUR PROFILE You'll feel at home here if: You've been the analyst inside a mobile product squad. Event tracking, funnel and user journey analysis, experiments. You plan around release cycles and handle old app versions as a matter of course You've managed analysts without stepping away from the work yourself Experimentation is where you're strongest. You’ve run plenty of A/B tests, and you can talk through bandits, quasi-experiments and where Bayesian and frequentist approaches part ways You've built a data quality regime. You've held a number back because it didn't reconcile, then gone and fixed whatever let it through You write SQL all day and Python when you need it, and dbt is how you transform data When you take an analysis to a PM, it comes with what you'd do next. And when a number turns out to be wrong, you say so and change the process that produced it Bonus points for: Experience with subscription businesses, including the mobile gateway SDKs (App Store, Google Play) A strong statistics background Dagster or Airflow for scheduling Data catalogues like DataHub OUR CORE TECH STACK Here's what we run in production: Warehouse: Snowflake Transformation & orchestration: dbt, Dagster Experimentation: GrowthBook Self-service analytics: Omni ML workflows: Prefect GenAI: Claude If you've worked with a cloud warehouse, dbt and an experimentation platform in some form, the patterns transfer. AI is part of how we work here: writing and checking code, summarizing data and keeping documentation current. We'd want you to be critical about what it gives back. WHY US? jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer - Team Atlas
jobs.description: About the Role Banks and fintechs use Taktile to automate critical decisions, like credit and risk, in real time. We're building the infrastructure that makes financial institutions truly AI-native, and the backend is where the hard problems live. We're growing rapidly with enterprise customers across banking and insurance, and we're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join Team Atlas : a small, high-ownership team focused on the data infrastructure powering our feature computation platform. You'll own critical systems end-to-end, and your decisions will shape the product. What You'll Do Build and operate backend services in Python on AWS — Lambda functions, DynamoDB, Aurora, and event-driven pipelines that handle real production traffic. You'll leverage agentic AI tools as part of your daily workflow. Tackle hard backend problems — latency, reliability, and scale are everyday concerns. Own your systems end-to-end: from architecture and implementation to deployment, monitoring, and incident response. Make key architectural decisions — you'll have real authority over how things are built, not just what gets built. Raise the bar for the team through code reviews, mentoring, and improving our development tooling and processes. Work directly with Product and Design to shape what we build next. Requirements At least 7 years of professional software engineering experience, with a proven track record of leading complex projects in a senior capacity (2+ years). Deep expertise building backend systems on cloud platforms, we use AWS. Strong system design skills — you're comfortable making architectural trade-offs and defending them. Depth in at least one of these areas: data pipelines and storage, event-driven architectures, caching and performance, or serverless systems. You don't need all of them. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to align technical and non-technical stakeholders on a shared vision. The ability to work in a hybrid model from our Berlin HQ, the London office, or the Iasi hub. Please note that relocation assistance is not provided for this role. Ideal, But Not Required Python, FastAPI, Apache Iceberg, AWS Athena, AWS Glue, or Apache Spark Streaming / real-time data pipelines (Kinesis) Multi-level caching strategies (Redis, DynamoDB, in-memory) Serverless at scale (Lambda, SAM, CloudFormation) Our Offer Work with colleagues that lift you up, challenge you, celebrate you and help you grow. We come from many different backgrounds, but what we have in common is the desire to operate at the very top of our fields. If you are similarly capable, caring, and driven, you'll find yourself at home here. Experience a truly flat hierarchy and communicate directly with founding team members. Having an opinion and voicing your ideas is not only welcome but encouraged, especially when they challenge the status quo. Learn from experienced mentors and achieve tremendous personal and professional growth. Get to know and leverage our network of leading tech investors and advisors around the globe. Receive a top-of-market equity and cash compensation package. Get access to a self-development budget you can use to e.g. attend conferences, buy books or take classes. Receive a new Apple MacBook Pro, as well as meaningful home office set-up. Our Stance We're eager to meet talented and driven candidates regardless of whether they tick all the boxes. We're looking for someone who will add to our culture, not just fit within it. We strongly encourage individuals from groups traditionally underestimated and underrepresented in tech to apply. We seek to actively recognize and combat racism, sexism, ableism and ageism. We embrace and support all gender identities and expressions, and celebrate love in its many forms. We won't inquire about how you identify or if you've experienced discrimination, but if you want to tell your story, we are all ears. About Us Taktile enables financial institutions to transform into AI

jobs.title: Lead Business Development Representative (m/f/d)
jobs.description: YOUR JOB Ready to lead from the front and still get your hands dirty? We are looking for ambitious BDR Leader who has mastered outbound and now wants to build, coach and carry a BDR team - while still owning a personal number. Start-up mode: you write the playbook, not just follow it. In this role, you will build and lead our BDR Team qualified pipeline for our Upper Mid-Market segment through targeted outbound, account-based prospecting, multi-touch sequencing, and close collaboration with Marketing and Account Executives. With AI-powered automation, self-serve capabilities, and additional tailored expert advice, we offer our customers a seamless security and compliance experience to stay ahead of the rapidly evolving security landscape and challenges like the surge in cyber-attacks. WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING Lead, coach and motivate a team of BDRs (stand-ups, call reviews, 1:1s) and lead by example by creating qualified pipeline yourself for our Upper Mid-Market segment through structured outbound prospecting, cold calling, email, LinkedIn, social selling and other creative engagement tactics. Execute marketing-owned outbound and ABM motions, including targeted account research, multi-touch sequencing and personalised outreach. Research target accounts, understand buying signals and create relevant first conversations with senior stakeholders. Qualify opportunities based on fit, urgency, business need and buying potential, then work closely with Account Executives to ensure a high-quality handover. Own and evolve the BDR playbook: test new messaging, account angles and prospecting approaches where you see opportunity. Set and track team KPIs, keep CRM data clean and use insights to steer prioritisation and individual performance. Help hire and onboard new BDRs, and collaborate closely with Marketing, Sales, Revenue Operations and Enablement to improve outbound strategy, messaging, conversion and feedback loops. WHAT YOU'LL GET IN RETURN The proper tools and capacities to build up and lead an ambitious, international team with diverse skill sets Enjoy the freedom and trust to bring in and execute your ideas with a quick pace, autonomy, and the ability to make impactful decisions. Gain strategic insights into management topics with the opportunity to actively contribute, working closely alongside leadership and executive peers. Rapid development opportunities, attractive performance bonuses, and the opportunity to strengthen your leadership skills and business expertise Step into a stable, forward-looking role within a dynamic scale-up poised to shape the fast-growing Security & Compliance industry THE QUALITIES YOU'LL NEED FOR A SUCCESSFUL CAREER AT DATAGUARD 2+ years’ experience as a BDR/SDR, ideally in B2B SaaS, with a consistent track record of hitting or beating quota. Outbound fundamentals you could teach in your sleep, including cold calling, email sequencing, account research, objection handling and qualification. jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer (all genders)
jobs.description: Parking without barriers, tickets or queues. Wemolo builds its own hardware and its own AI to make that happen. More than 7,000 of our scanners run on around 4,000 parking sites across Europe and have processed over 1.3 billion parking events: unattended, outdoors, around the clock. As Applied AI Engineer (all genders), you work like a forward deployed engineer, embedded with our internal teams. AI is reshaping how we work: you find where it has the highest impact, decide what is worth building, and then build it. You work closely with team leads across departments and within our Data & AI team. The role combines discovery and hands-on engineering: you split your time between working with teams and building the solutions yourself. User pain points are often vague at first, and priorities change as we learn which use cases hold up. Once a solution works, you hand it over and move on to the next problem. Pure coding, pure advisory work or polishing a single system for months are not part of the job. If turning unclear problems into working AI solutions is your thing, you’ll feel at home here. As we are looking for a hands-on engineer, a coding interview is an integral part of our interview process. What to expect Discovery: Shadow processes and interview the people doing the work. Quantify and validate where time and quality are lost. Prioritization: Prioritize use cases across departments by impact, not by what is easiest or needs the most advanced tooling, and say no to the ones that don’t hold up. Make or buy: Test existing tools and new AI providers against our use cases before building. Build and ship: Build the solution yourself: LLM based systems, traditional ML, rule based automation, or a combination, depending on the problem. Ship a first usable version within weeks, integrated into the tools people already use, and iterate based on feedback. Measure success: Define success upfront: business outcome, adoption and metrics that measure output quality. Own the outcome: Own each solution until it has a clear outcome: handed over to our Platform team or the domain team, or shut down. Platform: Build on our AI & Data platform and feed back what it needs next. Inspire us by Background: 3-5 years in software engineering, data science or ML engineering, including at least 1 year shipping LLM based products. Scale-up experience and close work with business teams such as operations or sales are a plus. Discovery experience: You have found and scoped problems yourself, working directly with users, and turned them into a quantified case for or against solving them. Technical skills: Good Python skills and a solid understanding of core GenAI concepts and building blocks, including RAG, tool calling, MCP, agent frameworks, and evaluation (Evals). Experience with traditional machine learning techniques (e.g., XGBoost) and SQL is a plus. End-to-end delivery: You have taken at least one AI project from an unclear business problem to production, implemented it end to end and can show how you measured its output quality. Analytical thinking & communication: You bring structure to ambiguous problems and explain technical trade-offs to non technical teams. You defend your decisions on which use cases to pursue and work as an equal with stakeholders. Mindset: Proactive and comfortable driving topics in unclear situations. You don’t wait for requirements, you find the problem worth solving. Language skills: Fluent English (C1); German is a plus. What we offer Flexibility & Responsibility: Your workday, your performance – Our hybrid model empowers you to focus from home, get fresh perspectives during workation, and connect in person during our Anchor Days (Tuesday to Thursday) Tailored Mobility: Full speed ahead – Whether it’s sustainable bike leasing or a public transport subsidy, we keep you flexible and on the move Measurable goals: Our agile methods allow you to directly measure your impact on our product and company succes

jobs.title: Senior Fullstack Engineer (f/m/d)
jobs.description: At Upvest, we are on a mission to make investing as easy as spending money . Upvest empowers businesses to offer a wide range of investment products and the best experience in the field of capital market investment and retirement planning. Upvest’s Investment API is easy to integrate so that fintechs and financial institutions can save resources and fully focus on their core business. We are proud to partner with Europe’s leading Fintechs and financial institutions such as DKB, Revolut, N26 and Raisin. Founded in 2017 by Martin Kassing, Upvest now brings together over 270 talented professionals from more than 70 nationalities. Upvest is backed by €280M in total funding from world-class investors, including BlackRock, Tencent, Sapphire Ventures, and Bessemer Venture Partners, Earlybird, Notion Capital, and Motive . Our latest €105M funding round in March 2026 - led by Sapphire and Tencent - serves as a massive catalyst for our growth, allowing us to offer premier investment experience. About the role: Team's mission Upvest's core product is an API: the execution layer that moves securities for our clients. Upfront extends into the layer above it. It's Upvest's operational service panel for enterprise clients, giving their operations, support and compliance staff the ability to handle first-line requests themselves: looking into an end-user's account, checking what happened to an order, answering the question in front of them. Today their options are to ask Upvest support or to build a service panel of their own, which most of them won't do. Our mission is to prove that financial institution customers can replace their fragmented operations with Upfront. That case isn't settled yet, and this team is the one making it. Our users do this work all day, so a clumsy interface is how a task turns back into a ticket for us. Our clients are already asking what AI can do for their operations teams. Agentic operations, exposed over MCP, is where we think this goes. What it should look like in Upfront is still open, and we'd like the person in this role to help define it. Upfront is part of the Clients Tribe at Upvest. Together with the Public API and Tooling Apps teams we enable Upvest’s business to scale efficiently, accelerate our client’s time-to-market and embed intelligence and automation into client processes. Your mission You’ll focus on building what actually creates value for our clients. While our OKRs set the destination, we expect you to help map the route. We prioritize impact and shipping speed over a perfectly groomed backlog. Because you're on a client-facing team, the quality of your output directly impacts client trust – especially since we are handling their customers' money. In our domain, the bar is high: anything touching client funds must be correct and auditable, or it's an incident. We will give you the client context, access, and autonomy to figure out what needs building, rather than just handing you a rigid spec. We also expect you to challenge our internal processes if they are slowing down your efficiency or shipping speed. What you’ll do: Take operational problems from concept to production, working across our React/TypeScript frontend and Go backend services. Own modern interface security. Upfront is where external users act on real end-user data, so you will tackle per-client isolated environments, least-privilege access, and Auth0 integrations in a regulated space. Expand the operational surface across Upvest's internal domains and develop a deep understanding of how our core systems piece together. Help define how software delivery works in an AI-enabled company by pushing AI tooling to its limits to maximize quality and speed while staying compliant. Build agentic operations as we move toward exposing Upfront over MCP. Every action requires a strict audit trail, so you will solve real design problems around what an agent can do autonomously versus what requires human intervention. Work in weekly cycles

jobs.title: Growth Associate - MUC - FT - Lisa
jobs.description: Growth Associate (Munich) AI is fundamentally changing how enterprises operate. For decades, procurement teams have relied on spreadsheets, emails and fragmented processes to manage billions in spend. As AI agents take over increasingly complex workflows, that’s about to change. As a Growth Associate, you open the first door into these accounts. You’re not just booking meetings: you’re creating the first impression of Lio. You’re the first conversation a CPO has with Lio, and you’re on the fast track to closing these deals yourself. And you don’t just run the playbook, you help write it: you own projects that make our whole go-to-market engine faster and smarter. Location: Munich, in office WHAT YOU’LL DO Build pipeline Find the right people in target accounts and start conversations that matter to them, through outbound and inbound Research accounts properly and write outreach that targets each persona’s real pain Build creative outreach strategies across email, LinkedIn and phone, and test what actually gets a CPO to respond Run qualification and hand opportunities to our AEs with the context they need to win Improve the playbook Design and test new outbound plays (signals, sequences, events) and turn what works into the team’s playbook Own side projects that move go-to-market forward, whether it’s a new channel, a tooling setup or helping us hire Share what you hear from customers with Product and Marketing, and help shape our messaging WHO YOU ARE 1-3 years of experience in GTM: SDR, sales, business development or growth, or a related start in VC, consulting or a founder’s office Ownership by default: you don’t wait for instructions or permission, you make things happen Builder mindset: when you see a process that’s slow or broken, you fix it, and you love using AI and new tools to do it Persistence and consistency: a first “no” is where it starts, not where it ends. You also read the room and learn where to push and where to give space. Clear communication, so you build trust with senior stakeholders quickly and know how to create excitement, whether you’re talking to a Fortune 500 executive or a buyer on the factory floor Attention to detail and ownership of your pipeline, from first touch to handoff You thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment and adapt quickly to AI-driven change YOUR PATH This is where your GTM journey starts. Hit your targets, and within about 12 months you’re an AE owning complex enterprise deals end to end, or you grow into a growth role that owns and scales how we generate pipeline. Along the way, you gain extensive GTM experience in scaling a startup in a high-paced environment. WHY JOIN US Silicon Valley DNA, built in Europe: backed by a16z, with the same ambition, speed and culture, in Munich Exposure from day one to Fortune 500 companies and C-level procurement leaders running large-scale transformations A team that moves fast, values impact and gives you room to grow. No endless approval processes, no politics, no waiting for permission. Joining early: the category is still being defined and the playbook is still being written Competitive salary plus equity Have questions about the role? Feel free to reach out to Lisa . Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Commercial Lead, DACH
jobs.description: We’re Heidi. We're building the future of healthcare by giving every clinician the earth's finest AI Care Partner. Our platform has absorbed the administrative chaos of 175 million patient visits and supported 67 million clinical hours. Today, we support 2.8 million patient sessions a week across 190+ countries, in 110 languages and over 200 specialties. Healthcare systems are failing us; clinicians spend more time on documentation than on patients, and the human connection that makes medicine worth practicing is eroding. Our mission is simple: double the world’s capacity for care and strengthen the human connection at its heart. We found product-market fit with a freemium medical scribe that clinicians love. Now, we're expanding. Every task a clinician hands to Heidi is a patient who feels more attended to, a health system unclogged, and a clinician who gets to be a clinician again. We’ve grown annual recurring revenue from $1 million to $50 million in two years. To go further, we’ve secured US$340 million: a $100 million Series C led by Blackbird, with Phoenix Court, Point72 Private Investments and Headline, alongside a $240 million growth investment led by General Catalyst’s Customer Value Fund. If you want to join us in doing work worth shipping, jump in. The role We’re looking for an experienced seller with an entrepreneurial mindset to help build Heidi’s next stage of growth across Germany, Austria and Switzerland. There’s already momentum: clinicians using the product, customers recommending us and healthcare organisations coming to us with interest. You’ll build on that foundation by closing strategically important deals, creating new pipeline and turning individual adoption into broader organisational relationships. This is a hands-on individual contributor role with a broad commercial remit. You’ll personally own opportunities from first conversation to signed agreement, while helping us develop partnerships, strengthen our market presence and figure out where to focus next. You might spend one day building a business case with a hospital group, the next prospecting into a priority account, and another working with a potential partner or helping shape a local event. You’ll bring the judgement to choose what matters and the follow-through to make it happen. What you’ll do Own strategically important deals: Lead opportunities with practice groups, MVZs, clinics and hospital groups from discovery and demos through business case development, negotiation and close. Build relationships with clinical champions, operational leaders and executive decision-makers. Build your own pipeline: Identify the accounts and segments worth pursuing, develop a clear approach and do the outreach yourself. Use targeted prospecting, introductions, local networks and creative approaches to open conversations. Convert the demand coming to us: Respond quickly to inbound interest and use product adoption signals to uncover larger opportunities. Recognise when an enthusiastic clinician could become the starting point for a practice-wide or group-wide rollout. Help buyers reach a decision: Understand their workflows, priorities and buying process. Bring the right stakeholders together, coordinate internal support on technical, security and procurement questions, and give pilots clear success criteria and a route to rollout. Help build the wider market: Develop relationships with software providers, professional associations, clinical advocates and other potential partners. Work with colleagues on conferences, webinars, customer stories and commercial initiatives that create trust and qualified demand. Improve how we sell: Turn what you learn into better messaging, account prioritisation and sales processes. Use AI and commercial tools to improve your effectiveness, keep the CRM accurate and maintain a realistic view of your pipeline and forecast. jobs.title: Social Content Manager
jobs.description: Bei Jellyfish glauben wir an die Kraft vielfältiger Perspektiven und an eine inklusive Zusammenarbeit. Wir begrüßen Menschen, die in diversen, kollaborativen Teams über sich hinauswachsen und die individuellen Sichtweisen anderer schätzen. Jellyfish ist eine globale Digital Marketing Agentur – eine einzigartige Verbindung aus Tech-Enthusiast:innen, kreativen Köpfen sowie Media- und Daten-Expert:innen, die ein gemeinsames Ziel vereint: unsere Kund:innen auf ihrer digitalen Reise weiterzubringen. Unser Anspruch, unterschiedliche Blickwinkel aktiv einzubinden, ist der Treibstoff für unsere innovativen Lösungen und Strategien. Wir hinterfragen den Status quo, denken Media-Aktivierung neu und entwickeln Stories mit Wirkkraft, für unsere internationalen Kund:innen und deren Zielgruppen. Gestalte mit uns eine Zukunft, in der berufliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung Hand in Hand gehen. Stellenbeschreibung Du berichtest direkt an den Senior Social Content Manager und sorgst vom ersten Tag an für spürbaren Impact in unserer paneuropäischen Social-Creative-Abteilung. Wir sind stolz auf unsere langjährigen Partnerschaften mit globalen Entertainment-Größen und auf unsere Arbeit, die Kultur prägt und sich von der Masse abhebt. Von unserem Berliner Hub aus – mit echter hybrider Flexibilität – treibst du Social-First-Storytelling und kulturelle Relevanz für eine führende Streaming-Marke auf dem deutschen Markt voran. jobs.description: WHO WE ARE Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant. Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach. Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions. BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO Shape the architecture of the world’s first commercial fusion power plant – Own system-level decisions that determine how a first-of-a-kind energy technology is designed, integrated, and ultimately deployed at scale. Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges – Work across tightly coupled disciplines (plasma physics, magnets, cryogenics, manufacturing, controls, and more) to resolve critical trade-offs and turn cutting-edge science into a functioning product. Design real hardware with a pragmatic, fast-moving team from all over the world – Combine advanced simulation and systems thinking with a strong execution mindset, focusing on practical engineering solutions that accelerate the path to commercial fusion energy. YOUR IMPACT You will deliver the helium refrigerator and cryogenic distribution for Proxima's Alpha coil test facility, taking these systems from requirements and process design through procurement, installation and commissioning. You will also support the engineering of the refrigerator for the cryopumps of the neutral beam injectors and divertor, and act as the process and safety owner for these systems. jobs.title: Staff Applied Scientist, Location Intelligence
jobs.description: Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction . Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people , making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone. THE TEAM • ~160 people , around half in engineering, product and data • 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research • Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle • An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking , tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation Every parcel ends at a door. Where that door is, where a courier can park, and which way they walk in decide whether a handover takes seconds or minutes, and whether anyone ends up at the wrong place at all. Most of that never shows up on a map. Relay sees the last mile through couriers' own devices: GPS traces from live deliveries that show where they park, which entrance they use and how long each handover takes. Turning those traces into a trusted picture of the real last mile is the foundation the rest of our Science builds on. Science at Relay is the brain of the operation: machine learning, operational research, recommender systems, causal inference, location intelligence and experimentation, working together to decide how every parcel gets delivered. Location intelligence is where it starts. Location Intelligence Highlights Telematics from the couriers who deliver for us: GPS traces, stops, parking spots and building entrances, all from live deliveries. Mapping and road networks: where addresses and front doors really are, and how roads and traffic really behave. A foundation layer: your work feeds routing, optimisation and courier intelligence, and gives our decision teams the evidence to tell a wrong address from a failed handover. One of the first hires into Relay's new Location Intelligence team, with room to set the direction. The Opportunity As a Staff Applied Scientist, Location Intelligence at Relay, you'll: Lead location intelligence at Relay, turning telematics and map data into a trusted picture of where deliveries really happen. Build the methods that find the front door: map matching, stop and dwell detection, and parking and entrance inference from messy GPS traces. Model road networks, traffic and travel times, so routes and plans reflect how the city really moves. Take models from prototype to production, and own their quality once they are live. Partner with Operational Research, Courier Intelligence and Engineering so correct addresses and doors flow into routing and decisions. Raise the standard for location science at Relay, and grow the team, the research culture and our voice in the tech community. We're looking for candidates who… Have hands-on experience with telematics or GPS data: individual traces, map matching, and stop or dwell detection. Have worked on a mapping or location product, whether an online maps platform or an internal mapping product for a delivery or mobility app. Come from a STEM background, with strong statistics and solid data and coding fundamentals. Have shipped location models into production, and owned them after launch. Have set technical direction that others worked to, and brought people with them. Collaborate generously, and explain complex ideas simply. Don't tick every box? If this problem excites you, we'd still love to hear from you. Who Thrives at Relay? Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact

How many people live quiet lives of misery? How many generational talents do we miss due to circumstance? Dex’s mission is to close the gap between Talent & Opportunity, we believe that work, and being productive, is part of the human condition, that regardless of AI, human passion, ingenuity and a desire to do things means that work will always exist. We are building Dex to create a future where technology helps every individual to understand their strengths, interests and unique abilities, and to connect with opportunities where they can thrive, because more people doing things they love leads to a better, happier and more productive world. We are starting by connecting the world's most ambitious software engineers with the companies that deserve them. About Dex Dex is backed by Notion Capital, a16z and Concept Ventures, with angels from OpenAI, Wise, ElevenLabs, Meta’s board, and many more. We’re an ambitious, direct and kind group of people, we value authenticity, ambition and people who make things happen. We’re a team of 28 (and growing) based in London. We work together 3 times a week because we value in person time, but we’re person centric and flexible. We hire adults who can manage their own schedules. The Role 40,000+ engineers have joined Dex, and we plan to 10x that in the next year. To get there we’re building a growth engine: channels, tools and agents that find the right engineers and get better every week. This role helps build and run it. It’s a broad role on the candidate side of Dex. One week you might launch a new acquisition channel. The next you might build a lead magnet, run a test on the website or ship a free tool like our engineer salary benchmark . What ties it together is systems: you’ll build the automations, agents and reporting that let a small team do the work of a much bigger one. You’ll learn growth from people who have done it before. Rob, our Head of Growth, led product growth at Cleo, and Luca, our Growth Lead, has built large B2B go-to-market teams. You’ll work directly with both of them, alongside Dex’s founding team, and see up close how a growth team gets built. Dex is AI-first: agents run our growth channels, our weekly reports are automated , and everyone here builds with Claude. You’ll work the same way from your first week. It’s for someone early in their career who is technical, commercially minded and wants to start a company one day. You don’t need growth experience. You need to think in systems, stay comfortable when nobody has defined the problem yet, and want more ownership than most companies would give you this early. What You’ll Do Own part of the growth engine: take on whole areas of how engineers find and join Dex, with targets for good candidates and the freedom to decide how to hit them. Build with AI: create the agents, automations and internal tools that take manual work off the team, and help work out how an AI-first growth team should run. Scale our acquisition channels: run and improve channels across paid, the jobs feed and creators. You’ll be hands-on in each one, finding what limits it and fixing it. Launch new channels: take a channel from first idea to a working system, test it against our own quality numbers and tell us plainly whether to scale it or stop. Build tools and lead magnets: ship free tools and resources that help engineers with their careers and bring them to Dex. Run website tests: design and run experiments on our site and landing pages, and make the winners the default. Own the numbers: build the reporting that shows what’s working across channels, and use it to decide where we put time and budget next. jobs.description: <p><strong>Location: </strong>London, UK – Hybrid (2 days per week in office)</p> <p>With millions of diners, 70,000+ restaurant partners and 25+ years of experience, OpenTable, part of Booking Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: BKNG), is an industry leader with a passion for helping restaurants thrive. Our world-class technology empowers restaurants to focus on what matters most – their team, their guests, and their bottom line – while enabling diners to discover and book the perfect restaurant for every occasion.&nbsp;</p> <p>Every employee at OpenTable has a tangible impact on what we do and how we do it. You’ll also be part of a global team that includes and its portfolio of metasearch brands. Hospitality is all about taking care of others, and it defines our culture.</p> <p><strong>About the job</strong><strong><br></strong>OpenTable is looking for a highly motivated, practical, and business-oriented Senior Counsel, Privacy &amp; Product to join our Legal team. You will serve as a trusted advisor to OpenTable’s Product, Engineering, Security, Commercial, Partnerships, and Marketing teams, providing strategic and practical counsel across product development, privacy and data protection, artificial intelligence, information security, consumer protection, and related regulatory matters. You will also serve as OpenTable’s Deputy Privacy Officer, helping lead and operationalize OpenTable’s global privacy program and serving as a key liaison with Booking Holdings, Inc. (BHI) on privacy and data protection matters. This role is ideal for a lawyer who enjoys working closely with commercial, product and technical teams, navigating emerging areas of law, and developing practical solutions that enable responsible innovation at scale.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Serve as a primary legal partner to OpenTable’s Product, Engineering, Security, Commercial, Partnerships, and Marketing teams, providing end-to-end counseling on new products, features, data uses, integrations, consumer experiences, and other strategic initiatives.</li> <li>Serve as Deputy Privacy Officer for OpenTable, helping lead and operationalize OpenTable’s global privacy program and serving as a key liaison with BHI on privacy strategy, governance, regulatory developments, and group-wide privacy initiatives.</li> <li>Advise on global privacy and data protection requirements and embed privacy-by-design principles into OpenTable’s products and operations, including counseling on data collection, use, sharing, retention, consent, personalization, and consumer rights.</li> <li>Provide strategic legal guidance on the development, deployment, procurement, and use of artificial intelligence and emerging technologies, including generative AI and AI-powered product features, and help develop scalable AI governance frameworks as the regulatory landscape evolves.</li> <li>Provide strategic legal advice and guidance to Product teams regarding product development, launch, and sunsetting, with strong focus on legal risks related to data privacy, cybersecurity, data usage and ownership, consumer protection, and marketing.&nbsp;</li> <li>Partner closely with OpenTable’s Information Security team on cybersecurity and data security matters, including product and vendor security risk, security requirements, incident response, potential data breaches, regulatory obligations, and remediation.</li> <li>Identify and address emerging product, privacy, AI, security, consumer protection, and regulatory risks; draft and negotiate related agreements and terms; and develop scalable legal processes, policies, playbooks, and disclosures that enable the business to innovate responsibly.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Minimum Qualifications</strong></p>

jobs.title: CDI - Senior AI Engineer - Paris
jobs.description: <h2>Mission</h2> <p>De nouveaux modèles, ouverts ou fermés, sortent chaque mois : encore faut-il choisir ceux qui sont assez bons pour la production, et le démontrer. Applications et agents s’appuient sur les grands modèles de langage (LLM), et la partie modèle de ces systèmes est entre vos mains. Nos clients s’en servent pour répondre à leurs propres clients, traiter des documents et interroger leurs connaissances.</p> <p>Ce que le modèle voit, la manière dont il retrouve les connaissances, les outils qu’il peut appeler : ces choix vous appartiennent, de même que la mesure de la qualité des réponses. Le modèle retenu doit tenir l’objectif de coût et de qualité.</p> <p><strong>Ce poste est fait pour vous si vous voulez savoir si un système d’IA donne des réponses justes, et pas seulement s’il tourne.</strong></p> <p>Artefact accompagne les plus grandes entreprises du monde dans le déploiement de l’IA : 3 000 AI makers dans plus de 30 pays, plus de 1 000 clients. En France, le département Engineering réunit environ 300 personnes sous la responsabilité du CTO ; vous y rejoignez le chapter AI Applied Engineer, archétype AI Engineer.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2>Activités et responsabilités</h2> <p>Les Product Engineers construisent l’application autour du modèle ; le comportement du modèle à l’intérieur vous revient. Les Context &amp; Analytics Engineers préparent les connaissances que vos agents retrouvent, et les Platform Engineers exploitent le serving, le harness et l’observabilité sur lesquels vous vous appuyez.</p> <p>Avec l’AI Product Manager et les experts métier du client, une bonne réponse se définit, puis les résultats s’examinent ensemble. La relecture de code entre pairs et l’accompagnement des nouvelles recrues font partie du quotidien.</p> <p><strong>Vos responsabilités :</strong></p> <ul> <li>Construire des applications et des agents LLM : conception du contexte, appel d’outils, workflows multi-étapes.</li> <li>Concevoir la façon dont les agents exploitent les connaissances : requêtes de retrieval, re-ranking, citations.</li> <li>Construire des jeux et des pipelines d’évaluation : réponses de référence, scoring automatisé, relecture par des experts métier.</li> <li>Suivre la qualité des réponses en production et corriger ce qui se dégrade.</li> <li>Choisir les modèles selon la qualité, le coût et la latence ; faire du fine-tuning ou de la distillation sur un modèle plus petit quand le prompting ne suffit pas.</li> <li>Ajouter des garde-fous contre les mauvaises réponses, les fuites de données et le prompt injection.</li> <li>Traiter des documents avec des LLM : extraction, classification, résumés.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2>Profil recherché</h2> <p><strong>Les indispensables :</strong></p> <ol> <li>Vous avez construit une application ou un agent qui appelle un LLM, et vous savez expliquer ce qui a fonctionné et ce qui a échoué.</li> <li>Votre code est testé et maintenable.</li> <li>Les coding agents font déjà partie de votre quotidien, et vous vérifiez ce qu’ils produisent.</li> <li>La qualité des sorties d’IA se mesure chez vous avec des jeux de test et des métriques, et vous savez limiter les hallucinations, le prompt injection et les fuites de données.</li> <li>Mettre en production une application LLM et la maintenir (déploiement, monitoring, coût, latence) n’a pas de secret pour vous.</li> <li>Le point de départ, pour vous, est le problème métier plutôt que le modèle ; reconnaître que l’IA n’est pas toujours le bon outil, et l’expliquer à des personnes non techniques, fait partie de votre pratique.</li> </ol> <p><strong>Un plu

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Paris
jobs.description: Who we are Yubo is the instantly social, social app: the leading real-time social discovery platform where you can meet new people for friendship, crushes and community. Our mission is to help young adults find community - whoever they are, wherever they are and whenever they feel social. That's why we’re building a more spontaneous and human social world, one based on interaction, exploration and possibility. We've pioneered a new way for Gen Z to socialize online, and with millions of active users, our goal is to redefine how we connect today and tomorrow. Our team is international, multicultural and deeply committed to its mission. As the leading platform to socialize online, we have a special responsibility to build a safe digital space for our community. Safety is embedded in our DNA, and our proactive approach focuses on user protection, support, and education. We also work closely with the broader technology industry to share our knowledge and NGOs create industry-leading child protection standards. Join us in this exciting journey and help us shape the future of social interactions! About this role At Yubo, Product Managers have real ownership. They work in strong partnership with Product Designers and Engineering, shaping strategy and decisions from problem definition all the way to delivery, with direct and visible impact on both the product and the business. We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to form that partnership with a Product Designer: a duo jointly responsible for the end-to-end experiences you ship together. You'll take ownership of a strategic product area, identify the biggest opportunities, and turn them into clear product bets on a product used by millions of people. We're moving away from small, isolated feature launches toward bigger, end-to-end experiences tested at scale . jobs.description: At Zoomo, our vision is to transition every commercial urban mile to light electric vehicles (LEVs) to build sustainable and more equitable cities. To that end, we are building the world’s most convenient, affordable, and safe e-bike platform. In 4 years Zoomo has helped transition millions of urban miles to light electric vehicles, built a team of >200 world class engineers, operators, sales staff and vehicle repair technicians; developed and deployed the world's best last mile delivery electric bikes and fleet management software; and successfully deploys these solutions around the world. We operate across the USA, UK, Europe, Canada and Australia. Zoomo vehicles are used by major players in the food, grocery and parcel delivery segments with partners including UberEats, Doordash, JustEat Takeaway, Deliveroo, Domino’s, Pizza Hut, Amazon, FedEx, Getir, Ocado, GoPuff and many more. The Role We’re hiring the most senior leader in France, reporting to the COO, to own market performance end-to-end: operational excellence, growth, and P&L outcomes. You’ll shape and improve our physical operations (fleet, workshop, retail), lead a hands-on team on the ground, and drive pragmatic growth initiatives (pricing, channels, partnerships) to build demand. This role requires an entrepreneurial operator with strong ownership, comfortable both running day-to-day operations and identifying opportunities to improve and grow the business. You can expect to: Drive local growth strategy: identify demand constraints and run pragmatic tests (pricing, offers, channels, local partnerships) with clear measurement. Stabilise and scale core operations (workshop + retail + fleet logistics). Expand capacity thoughtfully as demand grows, ensuring process discipline and cost control. Own the weekly operating cadence and core KPIs for France. Ensure pragmatic processes that keep the operation in control are implemented and digested by the team. Create a high-performance culture: clear ownership, measurable goals, fast problem-solving, and strong talent development. Act as the senior leader in France, partnering with central functions (Ops, Growth, Finance, Revenue, Tech, People) to set priorities, ensure support and deliver results. Handle local ‘GM admin’ with limited support: vendors, facilities topics, contracts coordination, and operational bureaucracy - solve problems end-to-end. Requirements 5+ years of experience managing frontline operations in a fast-paced, physical environment (last-mile, mobility, retail ops, field services, logistics). Proven track record improving measurable outcomes (throughput, quality, cost, availability, customer metrics) via hands-on leadership and process discipline. You have hired and led frontline teams; comfortable with performance management and raising the bar in junior teams. You are an entrepreneurial operator with a high-ownership mindset who thrives in ambiguous, decentralised international environments, proactively building solutions and driving impact without the need for constant direction. You have a bias for action and experimentation: identify levers, run tests (incl. pricing/channel changes), measure impact, iterate fast. Comfortable switching between floor-level detail (workshop/retail) and business planning (forecasting, stakeholder updates). jobs.description: At Parallel, we build AI agents that help healthcare organizations automate their administrative processes and unlock additional revenue, starting with medical coding. Today, up to 25% of healthcare spending is lost to manual, repetitive administrative tasks. Legacy software hasn't helped: it has made work slower, more complex and more frustrating for care teams. We believe AI agents can change this. Our technology combines large language models with system-level automation to do real work inside existing hospital tools. No integration, no disruption. Our first agent automates coding and frees up time for medical teams to focus on patients. We launched in 2024 and already have 800+ customers and a team of 30+ people. We are backed by top-tier investors (Index Ventures, Y Combinator, Hexa, Frst, Kima Ventures, Better Angle and the CEO of Mistral AI), and this is just the beginning. The future of healthcare isn't just digital, it's automated. Come help us build it! Context Every year, hospitals lose millions because of administrative tasks that are poorly coded, poorly billed or poorly processed, and their teams burn out doing them. Parallel deploys AI agents directly in hospitals to automate these processes, in one week where a traditional integration takes 12 to 24 months. The result: between €100K and €5M in revenue recovered per facility , and clinical teams who get their time back. Our public sector team is fully staffed. Private hospital groups are a different story: the first large groups are already live, more are coming, and a new portfolio of private groups is joining us. Until now, our founders and ops lead have handled these accounts directly. Now we need someone to own them. Your mission Own the relationship with around thirty of the largest private hospital groups in France (Ramsay, Vivalto and others), and make sure every ongoing deal moves forward and gets delivered. Manage training obligations, including the plan de développement des compétences, working with our OPCO, and supporting employees’ use of their CPF (compte personnel de formation). jobs.title: Staff AI Engineer - Agent Evaluation Platform (x/f/m)
jobs.description: Join a team of passionate and hardworking entrepreneurs to transform healthcare! Working in the tech team at Doctolib involves building innovative products and features to improve the daily lives of care teams and patients. We work in feature teams in an agile environment, while collaborating with product, design, and business teams. What you'll do We are looking for a Staff AI Software Engineer to join the AI Evaluation team (EvalX) at Doctolib and help every AI product team measure, understand and improve the quality, reliability and safety of their systems. Our AI products span patient-facing conversational agents, AI-powered phone assistants and clinical assistants supporting healthcare professionals. EvalX builds the platform, tools and methods that let these teams evaluate continuously, and our ambition is to make evaluation a core engineering practice. In this role, you will work at the intersection of platform engineering, applied AI and product teams: you build shared evaluation capabilities, and you work directly with the teams that use them so they actually get adopted. In this role, you will: Design, ship, and operate production-grade evaluation tooling (APIs, services, CI/CD integrations) used by AI product teams across Doctolib Work hands-on with product teams to assess how they evaluate today, define improvement plans, and help them own their evaluation quality Design evaluation strategies for agentic systems, combining deterministic checks, LLM-as-a-judge, simulation-based testing, and human review Build intelligent capabilities for production sampling, dataset representativeness monitoring, distribution-shift detection, and test case generation Help teams define meaningful quality metrics, representative datasets, and reliable quality gates throughout the development lifecycle Turn recurring product needs into reusable, self-service platform capabilities, and measure success through adoption, team autonomy, and evaluation coverage Contribute to cross-functional initiatives that shape Doctolib's AI platform and best practices for building and evaluating agentic systems Who you are Before you read on, if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply! You could be our next team mate if you: Have 6+ years of experience as a software engineer, with significant experience using Python; or as a machine learning engineer Have built or operated evaluation for LLM-powered or agentic systems: datasets, LLM-as-a-judge, human review, production-driven evaluation Understand and promote software development best practices Are product-oriented and enjoy working directly with other teams, challenging assumptions, and turning complex needs into concrete solutions Can influence engineering practices and drive change without hierarchical authority: your job is not done until your solution is adopted Are comfortable speaking and writing in English in your day-to-day with the team Now, it would be fantastic if you: Have experience with applied ML techniques such as embeddings, clustering, statistical sampling, and distribution monitoring Have experience building developer platforms or internal tooling, or in a Forward Deployed Engineering role Have experience in the medical domain or another regulated environment What we offer Free comprehensive health insurance (basic package) for you and your children 25 days of paid vacation per year, plus up to 14 days of RTT Free mental health and coaching services through our partner Moka.care Work from abroad for up to 10 days per year thanks to our flexibility days policy Lunch vouchers (Swile card) worth €8.50 per working day, with €4.50 covered by Doctolib A subsidy from the work council to refund part of the membership to a sport club or a creative class 50% reimbursement of your public transport subscription Enrollment in Doctolib's long-term employee value sharing plan called DoctoGrowth Paren

jobs.description: Who are we? The sea is the physical layer of the economy: our energy, data and trade move across it and under it. It is also Europe's most exposed flank. Cheap underwater drones, divers and mines now threaten ports, naval bases, subsea cables and offshore energy sites, and most of what is funded today stops at detection: it tells you a drone has entered the harbour, not how to stop it before it reaches the hull or the cable. Pelagon is creating the category of maritime interdiction : detection and action together. We design, deploy and operate protection zones around critical maritime infrastructure: a persistent sensing network running our own acoustic-first AI detects and classifies threats, and an underwater interceptor acts on them. We sell to navies and coast guards , and to the civilian operators of ports, subsea cables and offshore energy. Pelagon was founded by Aymeric de Pontbriand (serial deeptech entrepreneur, founded and exited Scortex) and Gauthier Bouxin (French Navy officer, then McKinsey). A team is already in place around them: a lead embedded systems engineer, a lead hardware engineer and an a chief of staff. We are backed by Hexa , the pioneer startup studio in Europe behind Front, Aircall and Spendesk. ⚡ What is at stake in the coming months Confirm the technology at sea with navies and operators. Deploy and sign our first paid pilots. Sign our first contracts. By joining us, you'll play a key role in turning that early traction into multi-year protection contracts, and in building the sales team that follows. 🎯 Your mission Own every deal from first meeting to signed contract, with navies, port authorities and operators of cables and offshore energy. Sell interdiction, not detection alone: make the threat and the gap between alarm and response concrete for each buyer, then turn pilots into multi-year protection contracts. Shape requirements before the tender: work with navies and operators months ahead of an RFP so that it asks for detection and action together. Open our priority export markets: the Baltic and the Nordics, the Black Sea, the Gulf and Southeast Asia. Work as a pair with Gauthier, our Co-CEO, on key accounts, and bring Aymeric and the engineers in when the technical conversation starts.
