jobs.description: Crisp is een van de snelst groeiende scale-ups in Europa. Klantretentie speelt hierbij een belangrijke rol. Daarom zijn we op zoek naar een allround stagiair die ons kan ondersteunen bij het continue activeren van onze klanten. Bij Crisp bevind je je in een uitdagende omgeving met veel kansen om te leren en jezelf te ontwikkelen. Wat je gaat doen Als Werkstudent Customer Retention krijg je een uniek inzicht in de wereld van consumentenpsychologie en de rol van marketing in consumentengedrag. Je ondersteunt de campagne & promotion specialists in ons Retentie-team bij een breed scala aan marketingtools, van promoties en prijzen tot heractivatie- en nieuwsbriefcampagnes. Je neemt volledig deel aan het Retentie-team en werkt nauw samen met onze Campaign- & Promotion Specialists, en onze Head of Retention. Enkele voorbeelden van wat je gaat doen: End-to-end uitvoering van e-mailcampagnes; van het aanvragen en selecteren van de juiste inhoud tot het instellen en uitvoeren van de technische details en het analyseren van de resultaten. 360-graden-uitvoering van onze promotiecampagnes, inclusief het selecteren van de optimale promotieproducten, het afstemmen met het forecast- en buyerteam, het creëren en verzenden van communicatie via meerdere kanalen, en het analyseren van resultaten. Het opzetten van A/B-testen om de effectiviteit van onze content en promoties te verbeteren. Dit ben jij Je bent parttime (16-24 uur per week) beschikbaar. Je bent in de mogelijkheid om doordeweeks overdag bij ons op kantoor te werken. Je hebt een passie voor consumentenpsychologie, marketing en promotie. Je hebt ervaring in het coördineren van projecten. Je hebt oog voor detail en je bent resultaatgericht. Je hebt (net als de rest van ons team) een passie voor duurzaam en lekker eten. Je spreekt en schrijft uitstekend Nederlands. Wat wij bieden De kans om je stempel te drukken op ons voedselsysteem met jouw inzet en ervaring en echte veranderingen teweeg te brengen. Enthousiaste en ondernemende collega's om mee te werken en van te leren. Een kijkje achter de schermen bij een van de snelst groeiende bedrijven op de Europese markt. Tijd om je collega's te leren kennen tijdens sport, evenementen en proeverijen. Een kantoor op Amsterdam Sloterdijk waar je kunt genieten van een goede lunch en een drankje. En... een flinke korting op je Crisp-boodschappen, want je wilt natuurlijk ook thuis goed eten. Onze selectieprocedure Solliciteer via onderstaande button. Hoe meer je kunt delen over jezelf en de reden dat je solliciteert, hoe beter. Bij Crisp streven we naar een inclusieve en diverse werkomgeving waarin iedereen welkom is, ongeacht hun achtergrond, geslacht, leeftijd, etniciteit, seksuele geaardheid, religie of beperking. We waarderen de unieke bijdragen die elke medewerker kan leveren en zijn vastbesloten om een inclusieve werkplek te creëren waarin iedereen wordt gerespecteerd en gewaardeerd. jobs.title: System Engineer (Control Systems)
jobs.description: System Engineer – Machine Control Location: Eindhoven, the Netherlands (on-site, High Tech Campus) | Type: Full-time | Level: Senior, 8+ years of relevant experience About us AIM Solutions is an early-stage deep-tech startup in Eindhoven building inspection and metrology equipment for the semiconductor industry. We are in an active build phase, small, and growing. The role You own how our tool is controlled and operated. The machine combines lasers, high-speed cameras, a nanometer-precision wafer stage and GPU-based image reconstruction. Every measurement depends on these parts working together in tight synchronization. You are the system engineer for that layer: the control architecture, the timing, the machine software, and the data path from sensor to result. You work side by side with our system engineer for the metrology hardware and with our algorithms team, and together you lead the system. You will: Own the system control architecture: machine software, control hardware, timing and synchronization, and the data path from acquisition to reconstruction Translate system performance and throughput goals into requirements for control, software and compute, and keep them traceable Own the timing, throughput and data budgets, and decide where time is won or lost in a measurement Define and guard the interfaces between control software, hardware and algorithms, including the hardware abstraction layer Define how the machine is operated: machine states, sequencing, recipes, error handling, logging and monitoring Steer the software and embedded engineers on the control side: set priorities, run design reviews and resolve trade-offs Set up integration and verification of the control layer, with a test strategy that keeps it reliable as the hardware changes between builds Carry the machine software from lab prototype toward a production tool that runs unattended in a fab Your profile 8+ years in high-tech equipment, including several years as a system engineer, software architect or control architect for a complex machine Experience with machine control in semiconductor, lithography, metrology or scientific instruments Hands-on understanding of real-time and deterministic systems: hardware triggering, FPGA-based synchronization, motion control and high-rate data acquisition Strong in equipment software architecture: layered designs, hardware abstraction, state machines and concurrency Comfortable reading code and reviewing designs in Python and C/C++. You won’t write most of the code, but you can. Strong in requirements, budgets and interface management across hardware and software This is not a role in a large organization with fixed processes: you help decide how we work. You thrive in a small, fast-moving team where roles are fluid, and you are as likely to be at the lab bench debugging a trigger as in a design review. A clear communicator with engineers, management and partners Full professional proficiency in English Bonus: Taking machine software from prototype to production, including SEMI standards for equipment communication and automation (such as SECS/GEM) and machine safety Integration with wafer handling and factory automation High-throughput data pipelines or GPU computing Experience with optical or imaging systems: cameras, lasers, image data Model-based systems engineering or modern requirements tools We care more about systems thinking and ownership than about a perfect match. If your title was software architect, control architect or lead engineer, but you have owned how a complex machine runs, apply anyway. We're doing the opposite: bringing ClickHouse Cloud into the environments our customers already trust, so their data stays useful right where it lives. Those environments come in a few shapes. Some are major cloud data platforms that run ClickHouse as a native service, so customers get it without leaving the tool they already use. Some are BI and visualization tools that need ClickHouse to show up as a fast, first-class data source behind their dashboards. And some are developer and data platforms we connect through marketplaces and identity federation with a couple of clicks or agentic calls. You'll have end-to-end ownership, but you'll also work inside the constraints of platforms you don't own: thin documentation, unfamiliar deployment topologies, and timelines governed by partner approval cycles. A lot of the challenge is engineering across trust boundaries you don't fully control. You won't be doing it alone. jobs.title: Lead Systems Engineer (Orbital Launch)
jobs.description: Lead Systems Engineer We are looking for a Lead Systems Engineer to act as the Systems Technical Authority for our orbital rocket programme. You will lead the vehicle-level systems effort, maintaining a coherent technical view of the complete vehicle and leading the definition, management, and resolution of system interfaces. Working with multidisciplinary teams across avionics, software, structures, propulsion, GNC, and more, you will manage the interdependencies between technical departments and use model-based systems engineering (MBSE) to keep system-level decisions connected. Your work will lay the technical foundation for successful vehicle integration and launch. About us We’re a Germany-based rocketry startup currently in stealth mode, scaling up rapidly to meet the demand for high-performance, reliable, and scalable solid propulsion technologies for space and defense applications. We are already launching suborbital and ballistic rockets on a regular basis, generating significant revenue and applying our knowledge toward the development of an orbital rocket. We are working hard to build something truly spectacular. To thrive here you will need to be comfortable working at pace, with the autonomy to make decisions and execute on them quickly. If you’re excited by hard technical challenges and want a role where you will make a real difference each day to the future of the company, we may be the place for you. Projekte eigenständig vorbereiten: Du stimmst Termine und Inhalte mit unserem Team und den Vereinen ab und sorgst dafür, dass aus dem Dreh veröffentlichungsfähiges Material wird. Drehs und Inhalte organisieren: Du stimmst Dich mit unseren Vereinen sowie mit Grafik, Projektmanagement und Vertrieb ab. Ob für ein Unternehmen, einen Verein, Deinen eigenen Kanal oder ein privates Projekt, ist dabei zweitrangig. Uns interessiert, was Du selbst umgesetzt hast. Außerdem wünschen wir uns: Einen sicheren Umgang mit Smartphone oder Kamera. Ein Gespür für spannende Momente, gute Bildausschnitte und Geschichten aus dem Vereinsleben. Interesse am Sport sowie Freude daran, auf Menschen zuzugehen. Zuverlässigkeit bei Absprachen, Terminen und der Übergabe Deiner Aufnahmen. So kann unsere Zusammenarbeit aussehen Wir suchen deutschlandweit und möchten ein Netzwerk aus Creatorn aufbauen, die unsere Projekte in ihrer jeweiligen Region begleiten. Du musst deshalb nicht in der Nähe unseres Büros in Gräfelfing bei München wohnen. jobs.description: <h3><strong>MUST HAVE UK WORK PERMIT. NOT A REMOTE ROLE, 100% IN-PERSON AT OUR LONDON OFFICE.</strong></h3> <p>Do you want to take part in defining the future of Private Equity? Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment, where you can gain a tremendous amount of responsibility quickly? Do you want to be part of an exceptional team with motivated and extremely driven people? Are you curious or passionate about event operations and logistics? If so, you might be our next member of the operations team.</p> <p><strong>About Private Equity Insights</strong><br>Private Equity Insights is the world’s largest Private Equity community with over 500k followers on LinkedIn, organizing a series of 12 global private equity events every year with 3,000+ GPs and 2,000+ LPs among the attendees. Private Equity Insights is part of <a href="https://www.united-media.com/">United Media,</a>&nbsp;which focuses on building large-scale industry media and conference products in sectors such as insurance, finance, retail, etc. As of today, we have organically launched 8 media companies and acquired one.</p> <p><strong>What We Offer You</strong><br>You get the unique opportunity to take ownership of one of our key business areas. You’ll be working in person at our HQ in London, where you will constantly be pushed out of your comfort zone. To ensure a never-ending growth curve, we provide you with:</p> <ul> <li>The opportunity of having a real impact - You’ll get operational experience in a growth company where your work and the results are tangible and have a high impact on the business.</li> <li>Unlimited growth potential in our company - We strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally.</li> <li>Invaluable transferable skills - Boost your interpersonal, research, organization, outreach, and project management skills through experience and training.</li> <li>Inspiration and guidance - A chance to work closely with our high-performing team as well as with the CEO and founder of our company.</li> <li>Travel opportunity - You will be attending our conferences.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Your Responsibilities</strong><br>Responsibilities in this job will vary; however, they will be mostly centered around the following:</p> <ol> <li><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Supplier Research and Management:</span> <ul> <li>Source, compare, and find the best suppliers for various event needs.</li> <li>Conduct thorough research to identify potential suppliers for add-ons, branding materials, and other event requirements.</li> <li>Negotiate contracts and terms with suppliers to ensure cost-effectiveness and high-quality services.</li> <li>Maintain positive relationships with suppliers, addressing any issues or concerns.</li> <li>Budget review and management to ensure all changes are raised ahead of time.</li> </ul> </li> <li><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Event Planning:</span> <ul> <li>Planning sponsored VIP events, lunches, dinners, and after-hours activities.</li> <li>Coordinating with venue staff to ensure all logistical details are in place.</li> <li>Provide on-site support during events, ensuring everything runs smoothly.</li> </ul> </li> <li><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Internal Team Support:</span> <ul> <li>Keep track and condense internal team queries.</li> <li>Maintain inventory tracking and regularly update event inventory sheets.</li> <li>Monitor Notion updates and ensure accurate reflection on the sponsor portal.</li> <li>

jobs.title: Senior Analyst, Permanent Control
jobs.description: Company Description We’re Checkout.com . You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day. We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers. Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale. If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact. With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started. Please make your application, including your CV, in English Language . We are a global compliance team headquartered out of London. About the role As a Senior Analyst – Permanent Controls , you will join the Permanent Controls team, a global Second Line of Defence (2LoD) function based across Paris and Mauritius. Reporting directly to the Head of Permanent Controls within the Compliance department, you will focus on the financial perimeter, exercising second-line control, independent oversight, and framework monitoring over the organization's finance domain. You will partner closely with the First Line of Defence (1LoD) to establish control standards, design control matrices, and provide guidance when needed. You will also execute 2LoD control plans, issue formal findings, and track recommendations through to resolution. Sitting in the Second Line of Defense, the global Permanent Controls team serves as an ongoing, trusted advisor and objective challenge to operational teams (1LoD), helping them design robust controls and ensure operational integrity across the organization. Unlike periodic audit functions, Permanent Controls operates continuously to proactively identify vulnerabilities, standardize control frameworks, and foster a strong risk culture. Note on Governance: This is a 2LoD function focused on ongoing control design, execution, and 1LoD enablement. It is distinct and independent from the Internal Audit (3LoD) function within Checkout.com. Key responsibilities Control Design: Collaborate with stakeholders to translate identified risks into comprehensive 2nd line control plans, standards, and templates. 1LoD Enablement: Partner with the First Line of Defence teams to design, refine, and assess their control matrices, ensuring alignment with internal standards and regulators' expectations (ACPR, FCA..). Execution & Testing: Formalize and execute second line permanent controls across critical perimeters, including: Financial regulatory reporting across global entities (France, UK, US, etc.). Accuracy of financial data, accounting standards, and reconciliations. Internal financial processes, procedures, and statutory compliance (including the Order of 3 December 2014). Safeguarding mechanisms (flow of funds, compliance with safeguarding measures, timelines, and incident monitoring). Reporting & Escalation: Present detailed control findings and anomaly reports to the Head of Permanent Controls; track the implementation of remediation recommendations. Proactive Continuous Improvement: Identify operational control gaps, take the initiative to propose practical solutions, and drive improvements to the overall control framework. Tooling & Automation: Contribute to the implementation and optimization of automated control tools, tracking dashboards, and recommendation monitoring systems whenever possible. About You Experience: 5 years of experience in Financial Audit, Internal Control, or Financial Reporting within the financial services (banking, Fintech..) or payments industry. Regulator

jobs.title: Testeur QA / Recette fonctionnelle (H/F) – Mission à mi-temps - FREELANCE
jobs.description: ImaginePartners recherche, pour l’un de ses clients, un testeur QA fonctionnel (H/F) pour une mission de 6 mois à mi-temps . Vous interviendrez sur plusieurs projets d’évolution du système d’information, dans un environnement principalement Microsoft. Votre rôle sera de valider les applications avant leur mise en production, de la préparation des tests à la vérification des corrections. Modalités de la mission Démarrage — Dès que possible Durée — 6 mois Rythme — Mi-temps, avec une répartition des jours à convenir Localisation — Région de Marseille, avec possibilité de travailler à distance TJM — À proposer Vos missions Analyser les besoins métiers et les spécifications, identifier les parcours à tester et définir la stratégie de test de chaque projet. Concevoir les scénarios, les cas de test et les jeux de données. Préparer et maintenir les plans de test. Exécuter les tests fonctionnels, d’intégration, de non-régression et de bout en bout. Participer aux campagnes de recette avant les mises en production. Qualifier et documenter les anomalies, suivre leur correction avec les développeurs et effectuer les contre-tests. Prioriser les campagnes entre les projets, communiquer les résultats aux équipes métiers et techniques et contribuer à harmoniser les pratiques de test. Profil recherché Vous avez une expérience significative en tests logiciels ou en recette fonctionnelle d’applications web ou de systèmes d’information d’entreprise. Vous savez mener une campagne de test en autonomie, documenter vos résultats et gérer plusieurs sujets en parallèle. Vous avez utilisé Azure DevOps, Jira ou un outil équivalent, dans un environnement Agile/Scrum ou en cycle en V. Une expérience sur Power Platform, Dynamics 365 ou SharePoint , la certification ISTQB Foundation et la pratique de l’ automatisation des tests sont appréciées. Pour postuler Joignez votre CV à votre candidature sur JOIN et indiquez votre date de disponibilité , votre localisation , v otre TJM HT et votre disponibilité à mi-temps . jobs.title: Outbound Account Development Representative - France
jobs.description: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. About the Role As an Account Development Representative (ADR) at Samsara, you will be trained, both on the job and with formal training programs led by a world-class team of sales professionals, to take on your next role as closing Account Executive.  On a daily basis, you will be responsible for sourcing pipelines for our EMEA business,  generating opportunities via outbound outreach.  We have offices in Munich, Paris and Amsterdam and we offer remote working from Germany, France, The Netherlands and London. Our European headquarters are based in London. This is a remote position open to candidates based in France, Germany, The Netherlands and United Kingdom. This position requires working hours in CEST. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role. You should apply if:  You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely. You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. Successful ADRs can see promotion to a closing role in two years or less. You love talking to people: In this role, you will average 60+ calls to prospective customers daily. You have an innate curiosity about how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support to make a larger impact. You treat rejection as a learning experience: In this role, you will get hung up on and you will get told no. You need to have the resilience to pick up the phone again and again to sell Samsara's mission. You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before. In this role, you will:   Drive pipeline through personalized outreach to prospects via phone, emails and Linkedin Have the opportunity to to participate in trade/shows events to represent the Samsara brand and connect with prospective customers and partners. Become a product expert and learn the Samsara way of selling Keep meticulous records of interactions with accounts in our CRM (Salesforce.com) Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices Minimum requirements for the role: 1-3 years professional experience, ideally in customer facing roles 6-12 months sales experience as a minimum Highly motivated and committed, with strong desire to work in target driven sales Proven track record of consistent over achievement of targets/expectations of previous roles Excellent communication skil

jobs.title: Senior Mechanical Design Engineer (Power Electronics)
jobs.description: Hyperscale Power is building the power backbone for the AI data center era: a complete power conversion chain from 13.8kV–35kV medium-voltage AC down to 800V DC, combining ultra-compact SiC-based power blocks. Our Solid-State Transformers (SSTs) are the core of this revolution, providing unprecedented control, efficiency, and compactness. As a Senior Mechanical Design Engineer, you will turn our power electronic modules into a robust, compact and safe product. You will design how the SiC-based power modules, magnetics, busbars and cooling come together into one unit, working closely with our power electronics, magnetics and thermal engineers. Instead of handing your designs over for someone else to build, you take them all the way: you calculate them, build and assemble the prototypes yourself in our workshop, and take the design from first prototype to a product ready for series production. This role is for you if… you've designed the mechanical integration of power electronics or other electronic systems and know your way around creepage, clearance and insulating plastics. You back your designs with solid calculations, and you're as comfortable with a screwdriver in the workshop as with CAD at your desk. This role isn't for you if… your experience is in classic mechanical design only, such as gears, gearboxes or pumps, or you prefer to stay at your desk while someone else builds your prototypes. It's also not a fit if you need technicians for assembly or established processes before you can start. Key Responsibilities Design the mechanical integration of power electronic modules into the SST: enclosures, holders, fixtures and jigs, and interfaces to the busbar system, with a modular design approach. Rivia was founded on the belief that new drugs can be brought to market more successfully with a fraction of today's capital. Rivia unifies clinical trial data at scale through a core engine built as a reusable intelligence layer, comprising hundreds of configurations and trial-specific logic, independent of source structure. This vertical stack of data engine, workflows, and agents creates a distinct advantage in how trials are operated. jobs.title: Director/Senior Director, EMEA Health Economics and Outcomes Research (HEOR) Leader
jobs.description: Scholar Rock is delivering muscle-targeted breakthroughs to transform the treatment of spinal muscular atrophy (SMA) and other rare neuromuscular diseases where muscle atrophy remains a critical unmet need. As a global leader in myostatin biology, a field focused on proteins that regulate muscle mass, the biopharmaceutical company is named for the visual resemblance of a scholar rock to protein structures. Our commitment to unlock fundamentally different treatment approaches is powered by broad application of a proprietary platform, which has developed novel monoclonal antibodies to modulate protein growth factors with extraordinary selectivity. Scholar Rock works every day to create new possibilities for patients through its highly innovative anti-myostatin program, including opportunities in additional rare neuromuscular diseases. Learn more about our neuromuscular franchise at ScholarRock.com and follow @ScholarRock on X and on LinkedIn.   Summary of Position: The Director/Senior Director, EMEA Health Economics and Outcomes Research (HEOR) Leader, reporting to the Vice President Global Medical Affairs, will lead the development and execution of the go-to market strategy and deliverables to support value of apitegromab as well as the clinical stage Scholar Rock portfolio, in close partnership with the cross-functional matrix team.  This individual will serve as the strategic leader and subject matter expert for EMEA HEOR, responsible for country-level budget impact and cost-effectiveness model adaptations, evidence generation plans, and value communications required to support the national health technology assessment (HTA), payer dossiers, EU Joint Clinical Assessment (JCA), and reimbursement negotiations of Scholar Rock treatments. The role requires strong strategic leadership and cross-functional collaboration with Medical Affairs, Market Access, Commercial, Clinical Development and the regional teams in EMEA to optimize access and reimbursement for patients worldwide.  The successful candidate will develop strategic partnerships and research collaborations with external experts, healthcare policymakers, payers and various academic centers to support the strategy for apitegromab and future products.  Position Responsibilities Develop HEOR strategies for EMEA, with an emphasis on Europe, that support product value demonstration, reimbursement, market access, and launch objectives. Lead the design, implementation, and oversight of HEOR studies, models, and deliverables for Europe. Collaborate with Medical, Market Access, and Biostatistics to determine real-world evidence needs for payers in Europe—including registries, natural history and external control analyses, burden of illness, treatment patterns, resource use, and addressing evidence requirements arising in HTA appraisal and reimbursement negotiations. Incorporate evidence gaps needed for European payers into evidence generation plans Direct evidence synthesis and value communication for payer and HTA bodies. Serve as Europe HEOR partner to Europe Market Access for access and reimbursement dossiers by providing country-specific adaptations of models, methodology guidance, and scientific reviews that support country-level deliverables. Own the HEOR deliverables for timely submissions to EU JCA, including PICO-driven evidence planning and comparative effectiveness analyses. Work closely across Global HEOR and cross-functional teams to inform endpoint, patient-reported outcome, and utility data collection strategy for clinical development programs so that trials generate evidence acceptable to payers and HTA bodies. Manage external HEOR vendors, budgets, and contracts, ensuring quality and timely delivery across competing priorities. Translate complex HEOR outputs and requirements into plain-language value narratives for internal leadership and external payers. Candidate Requirements Graduate degree in health economics, epidemiology, health services

jobs.title: Backend Software Engineer - Indexing
jobs.description: About us: DeepJudge is Switzerland’s leading AI and ICT scale-up, transforming how law firms and legal departments access and leverage their knowledge. Founded by former Google search engineers with PhDs in AI from ETH Zurich, and backed by top-tier Silicon Valley investors, we are building the intelligence layer that powers the legal industry. Every firm can license the same AI models, but no two firms share the same institutional knowledge. Decades of experience, work product, and precedent are often trapped across systems, underused and inaccessible. DeepJudge makes this expertise instantly available through world-class enterprise search and AI infrastructure, enabling firms to automate workflows, build knowledge-powered applications, and turn experience into a lasting advantage. Our technology is trusted by many of the world’s leading law firms, including Freshfields, Gunderson Dettmer, Holland & Knight, Arent Fox, and Cozen O’Connor. Headquartered in Switzerland with a growing team across North America, we are expanding rapidly and shaping the future of how professional knowledge is discovered and applied. At DeepJudge, we move fast, think rigorously, and care deeply about what we build. We combine cutting-edge research with close collaboration with our clients to deliver solutions that truly make an impact. If you want to be part of a team defining how AI transforms high-stakes knowledge work, this is the place to do it. About the Role: We’re looking for a Backend Software Engineer to join our team and take meaningful ownership from day one. You’ll work closely with smart, driven, and genuinely fun people who are passionate about tackling the complex challenges involved in building a high-performance product at scale. Our indexing system is the backbone of our search engine, processing queries over hundreds of millions of documents in fractions of a second. Building and maintaining these indices within tight time and resource constraints requires highly performant, scalable software. To achieve this, we rely on modern technologies in distributed and parallel computing, database systems, and cloud platforms. You’ll leverage the strengths of these technologies to meet demanding throughput and latency requirements. Your responsibilities will include: Design, develop, and maintain efficient, scalable backend services using modern tools and frameworks Take ownership of core components of our indexing infrastructure Collaborate with other engineers to define, design, and ship new features Optimize performance and scalability across our data processing pipelines Integrate with third-party data providers and effectively use their APIs Review code and contribute to a high standard of code quality and maintainability Participate in agile development processes, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives You're a great fit if you: Have a Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience Have 2+ years of experience as a Backend Software Engineer, ideally in a scale-up or fast-growing environment Have strong experience with concurrent and parallel programming and understand how to write correct, efficient code under load Are highly proficient in Python, our primary backend language. jobs.title: Product Owner
jobs.description: Product Owner Amsterdam - Lijkt het jou interessant om als product owner aan een applicatie voor miljoenen gebruikers te werken waarbij je grote invloed hebt op de architectuur en technische ontwikkelingen? Lees dan snel verder! Wat ga je doen? Als Product Owner bij Reclamefolder.nl ben je de operationele rechterhand van de Product Manager en zorg je ervoor dat het productteam altijd weet wat er gebouwd moet worden, waarom dat belangrijk is en hoe succes wordt gemeten. Je vertaalt inzichten uit klantgesprekken, data en gebruikersonderzoek naar concrete en uitvoerbare features. Daarmee lever je een belangrijke bijdrage aan de doorontwikkeling van een platform dat 872000 unieke bezoekers per maand ontvangt. Zonder jouw regie ontstaat onduidelijkheid over prioriteiten, scope en requirements, waardoor de ontwikkeling van het platform vertraagt. Dit doe je onder andere door: Productkeuzes en inzichten uit klantgesprekken, data en gebruikersonderzoek te vertalen naar goed uitgewerkte features met heldere user stories, acceptatiecriteria, edge cases en meetpunten. Refinements voor te bereiden, de backlog actueel en overzichtelijk te houden en ervoor te zorgen dat web-, iOS-, Android- en backendteams altijd vooruit kunnen werken. Het eerste aanspreekpunt te zijn voor developers, UX en de Tech Lead bij functionele vragen en binnen de gestelde kaders zelfstandig beslissingen te nemen over scope en uitwerking. De scope tijdens development te bewaken, functionele validaties voor te bereiden met testscenario's en acceptatiechecks en opgeleverde features te controleren op iOS, Android en web. Verzoeken van DPG Media, sales en andere interne stakeholders te analyseren, samen te werken met de UX'er en data-analist aan de juiste KPI's en meetpunten en advies te geven over prioritering. Wie zijn wij? Wij zijn Reclamefolder.nl. Wij geloven dat het mogelijk is om mensen te helpen besparen op hun dagelijkse uitgaven. Onze website en apps ontvangen wij maandelijks 875000 unieke gebruikers en onze ambitie reikt verder. We bevinden ons midden in een transformatie waarin de digitale folder volledig wordt vernieuwd en het platform opnieuw wordt opgebouwd. Reclamefolder.nl heeft een ondernemende cultuur met ongeveer 25 collega's binnen IT, marketing en sales. Hoewel we onderdeel zijn van DPG Media, opereren we zelfstandig. Hierdoor heb je veel invloed op de productontwikkeling en bedrijfsvoering, terwijl je tegelijkertijd profiteert van de kennis en expertise van een grote mediaorganisatie. Je werkt in een multidisciplinair productteam bestaande uit een Product Manager, webdeveloper, iOS-developer, Android-developer, backenddevelopers, een UX'er, een data-analist en een Tech Lead. In deze rol geef je de Product Manager ruimte om zich te richten op discovery, strategie en klantcontact, terwijl jij zorgt voor een backlog met features die klaar zijn om ontwikkeld te worden. Wat maakt jou de ideale kandidaat? 2 jaar ervaring als Product Owner Hbo-werk- en denkniveau, een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal en ervaring met het werken in multidisciplinaire productteams. Ervaring met het zelfstandig uitwerken van backlog-items voor een digitaal product en samenwerking met developers, bijvoorbeeld als Product Owner, Business Analyst of in een vergelijkbare rol. Ervaring met het schrijven van duidelijke user stories en acceptatiecriteria die zonder aanvullende toelichting door ontwikkelaars kunnen worden opgepakt. Het vermogen om stakeholderverzoeken te vertalen naar een helder probleem met een duidelijke scope en prioriteit, waarbij je waar nodig duidelijke keuzes maakt. Pré Ervaring met digitale producten die beschikbaar zijn op iOS, Android en web. Ervaring binnen retail media, advertising, e-commerce of marketplaces. jobs.description: Amsterdam or Antwerp – As a Backend Engineer within the GenAI Platform team, you help build the foundation that enables AI products across DPG Media. You design and develop scalable backend solutions that support identity, access management and platform insights for a growing portfolio of AI services. Ready to make an impact on the future of AI at DPG Media? Read on! What will you do? As a Backend Engineer, you take ownership of the platform capabilities that enable teams across DPG Media to securely use and manage AI products. You build backend services that unify user, access, usage and cost data while making architectural decisions that support the platform's continued growth. Your work ensures that new products and teams can be onboarded efficiently and consistently. You do this by: li]:mb-1 [&>li::marker]:text-base [&>li::marker]:text-gray-900 dark:[&>li::marker]:text-gray-100"> Defining how users, roles and permissions are managed centrally and applied consistently across every product on the GenAI Platform. Building backend services that collect, combine and expose usage, cost and user data for the platform portal and reporting. Designing scalable platform architecture that continues to perform as the number of products grows. Defining how platform resources are described so new products and teams can be added through configuration instead of custom development. Who are we? We are a small team that builds and operates the GenAI Platform used across DPG Media. The platform runs on Kubernetes and provides teams throughout the organisation with access to AI products, ranging from workflow automation to model hosting. What makes you the ideal candidate? For this role, we are looking for an experienced backend engineer who combines strong technical expertise with ownership and a pragmatic mindset. You are proactive, analytical and enjoy building scalable platform solutions. In addition, you bring: li]:mb-1 [&>li::marker]:text-base [&>li::marker]:text-gray-900 dark:[&>li::marker]:text-gray-100"> Around 5 years of backend engineering experience, including designing systems yourself. Proficiency in at least one backend language. We work with Go, TypeScript and Python, and you are willing to work across these technologies. Experience integrating third-party APIs and combining data from multiple sources into one consistent view. Hands-on experience with OAuth2/OIDC, role-based access models and running services on Kubernetes. Experience adding metrics and alerts to the services you build. Additional experience with Go, Kubernetes controllers or operators, declarative reconcile-based systems, usage metering, FinOps data, Terraform or GenAI systems is considered an advantage. How do you work? You take ownership of your work from design through delivery and beyond. You focus on delivering practical solutions first and continuously improve them. You proactively identify opportunities for improvement, clearly explain your reasoning and remain open to alternative perspectives. You think ahead when making design decisions and build with long-term scalability in mind. Our stack li]:mb-1 [&>li::marker]:text-base [&>li::marker]:text-gray-900 dark:[&>li::marker]:text-gray-100"> Languages: Go for the platform control plane, TypeScript and Python for services and APIs. Platform: Kubernetes (EKS) on AWS, Terraform, Helm and ArgoCD. Observability: Grafana, Prometheus and OpenTelemetry. CI/CD: GitHub Actions. At DPG Media, we are open to all talent in society. Regardless of your background, we invite you to apply for this position. It is precisely through the differences between colleagues that surprising insights and innovative solutions emerge. jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist (Applied ML) - Canada
jobs.description: At NerdWallet , our mission is to provide clarity for all of life's financial decisions. Data Science plays a critical role in delivering on that mission, helping us better understand our consumers, personalize their experiences, and connect them with the financial products that best meet their needs. We’re growing, and we’re looking for a Senior Data Scientist (Applied ML) to join us as a foundational member of our new team. You’ll help shape and advance our machine learning capabilities across consumer personalization, predictive modeling, and performance marketing, with a real voice in how we work from day one. Together, we’re building an inclusive, supportive team culture where we lift each other up and succeed together to drive business impact across the organization. In this role, you will lead the development of production-grade machine learning solutions that power some of NerdWallet's most critical business decisions. From predicting customer lifetime value and scoring incoming leads in real time to developing recommendation engines that connect consumers with the right financial products, your work will have a direct impact on how we acquire, engage, and monetize our customer relationships. This is a hands-on individual contributor role for someone with deep expertise in applied machine learning, production ML systems, and the Databricks ecosystem. As a foundational member of the team, you’ll partner closely with Data Engineering, Product, Marketing, and Analytics to translate complex business problems into scalable ML solutions, while helping establish the technical standards and best practices for machine learning across NerdWallet. Where you can make an impact: Build Predictive Models That Drive Business Growth Lead the end-to-end development of advanced machine learning models focused on customer lifetime value (LTV), conversion propensity, lead quality, and revenue optimization. Translate model predictions into actionable signals that improve marketing investment decisions, customer acquisition efficiency, and long-term profitability. Advance Personalization & Recommendation Systems Develop recommendation and ranking models that identify the most relevant financial products for individual consumers based on their needs, behaviors, and predicted propensity to engage or convert. Explore and implement approaches such as propensity modeling, learning-to-rank, and next-best-product recommendations to improve customer engagement and cross-sell opportunities. Collaborate with Product and Marketing to integrate predictive intelligence into consumer experiences and personalized communications. Establish Best-in-Class ML Practices Leverage Databricks and MLflow to develop, train, deploy, monitor, and manage machine learning models at scale. Establish robust DS practices, including experiment tracking, model versioning, feature engineering, automated training pipelines, model monitoring, and reproducibility. Define standards for model performance, reliability, retraining, and production readiness, including monitoring for data drift and model degradation. Design and evaluate experiments to measure the incremental business impact of deployed models and continuously improve their effectiveness. Serve as a technical leader within Data Science, mentoring other practitioners, influencing architectural decisions, and elevating engineering and modeling standards across the organization. Your experience: 5+ years of professional experience in Data Science, Applied Machine Learning, or a related field, with a demonstrated track record of developing and deploying ML solutions that drive measurable business impact. Deep, hands-on experience with Databricks, including building and managing production machine learning workflows using MLflow and the Databricks ML ecosystem. We partner with top researchers from both academia and industry, including Anthropic, Goodfire AI, Redwood, Princeton, MATS, RAND Corporation, and others. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, OS Integration
jobs.description: Why Mozilla ? Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people. The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms. About the OS Integration team: The OS Integration team ensures Firefox works well with the host operating system and environment. We’re a distributed team with expertise in Windows, macOS, and Linux-based operating systems. Our responsibilities include developing fixes and improvements for Firefox related to Windows, macOS, and Linux environments. This might include integration with a new OS feature or fixing an OS-specific user interface bug. Other responsibilities include native crash reporting, OS abstraction layers, sandboxing, hardening, installer, updater, device APIs, and enterprise DLP support. About the role: As a member of the OS Integration team, you’ll develop fixes, improvements, and new features for Firefox. The role will lean on your Windows expertise, but projects may have a cross-platform component. This role will include development of features for Firefox in enterprise environments especially implementation of Data Loss Prevention (DLP) features. As a Staff Software Engineer, you’re a clear communicator and expert in your domain, ready to work on multi-month projects. You’ll contribute to the team through code review, mentoring, and discussion. What you’ll do: Improve the quality of Firefox and other Mozilla products by debugging and fixing software defects, improving the browsing experience for hundreds of millions of users. Lead projects that improve the stability, security, and performance of Firefox. Collaborate with experienced software engineers. Perform code reviews and provide technical direction. Work with a geographically-distributed development team. Interact with teams throughout the organization. What you’ll bring: 7+ years of overall software engineering experience. Experience with desktop application development on Windows with C++. Advanced knowledge of C and C++ and a solid understanding of assembly language such as x64, x86, or arm64. Knowledge of web technologies such as Javascript, HTML, and CSS. Knowledge of secure coding practices and memory safety concerns. Strong problem-solving and debugging skills. Written and verbal communication skills with a collaborative mindset. Willingness to work effectively in a distributed team environment. Commitment to our values: Welcoming differences Being relationship-minded Practicing responsible participation Having grit Bonus Points for experience with: Enterprise DLP development or deployment Open-source contributions or personal engineering projects What you’ll get: Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute) Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday One-time home office stipend Annual professional development budget Considerable paid parental leave Employee referral bonus program Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by c

Passion for helping developers innovate with NVIDIA tools and technology. Ways to Stand Out from the Crowd: PhD or postdoctoral research experience in AI, robotics, natural sciences, or a related field. jobs.title: Clinical Formulary Pharmacist
jobs.description: Welcome! We’re excited you’re considering an opportunity with us! To apply to this position and be considered, click the Apply button located above this message and complete the application in full. Below, you’ll find other important information about this position. Reporting to the Manager of Clinical Pharmacy, the Clinical Formulary Pharmacist is primarily responsible for supporting development and maintenance activities for medical drug formulary for ASO, Medicare, and any future commercial lines of business as well as any pharmacy drug formulary development and benefit design needs with our contracted pharmacy benefit manager for all lines of business. The responsibilities of this position include working with the Manager of Clinical Pharmacy to monitor and analyze drug trends, new drug releases, and review primary literature that will ultimately drive pharmacy and medical drug formulary as well as the execution of necessary formulary work in compliance with accreditation and regulatory standards. In addition, this role will work collaboratively with our Medical Director and Utilization Management teams to develop complete and up-to-date utilization management criteria and to review any specialty medication requiring a specialty consult as defined by our formulary team. MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS: EDUCATION, CERTIFICATION, AND/OR LICENSURE: 1. Must possess current and unrestricted license to practice pharmacy issued by state of residence. EXPERIENCE: 1. Four (4) years of experience as a pharmacist in a clinical setting 2. Two (2) years of formulary or managed care experience PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS : EDUCATION, CERTIFICATION, AND/OR LICENSURE: 1. Specific knowledge of pharmacotherapeutics and drug study analysis 2. Experience in strategy, design and management of formulary preferred 3. Specific knowledge of pharmacoeconomics and drug impact analysis preferred 4. Specific knowledge of CMS regulations, HIPAA and regulatory environment preferred CORE DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: The statements described here are intended to describe the general nature of work being performed by people assigned to this position. They are not intended to be constructed as an all-inclusive list of all responsibilities and duties. Other duties may be assigned. 1. Creation of drug monographs and reviews of new drug entities to market in a timely manner as defined by accreditation or regulatory standards per line of business as well as formulary recommendations for all new drug formulations and indication or safety updates. 2. Update existing criteria and make recommendations regarding drug inclusion and utilization as new drug information becomes available. 3. Own the operational execution of all clinical and formulary decisions including working with operations team to ensure all formulary changes are implemented and maintained. 4. Own the communication needs for all clinical and formulary decision changes including website and criteria postings. 5. Drive pharmacy formulary strategy implementation by working with leadership to monitor and review drug trends, examine utilization management, and competitor strategies. 6. Ensure all drug policies and criteria are reviewed at least annually and remain accurate with the most up-to-date information. 7. Present and participate in discussion of medical literature review for evaluation of place in therapy for new drugs or disease management concepts in regular clinical policy discussion meetings with our Medical Directors and leadership. 8. Prepare all presentation materials for regularly scheduled P&T committee meetings timely and ensure documents are distributed to participants in advance of each meeting. 9. Present and actively participate in discussion of formulary recommendations made during regularly scheduled P&T committee meetings. 10. Work with Medical Directors and UM teams to review and make recommendations on specialty drugs requiring a specialty consult as defined by our organization. 11

Imagine having a trusted friend in your pocket who takes care of everything: they find you the right car or home at the right price, lock in the best insurance rate without you lifting a finger, remind you before that service appointment turns into an expensive repair, and help you sell at the best price when the time is right. Why We’re Hiring Our BizOps & Analytics team has been a force multiplier and accelerant to our business that has helped us reach these pivotal milestones in spite of headwinds and within a highly competitive market. They are a team of former McKinsey, BCG and Bain consultants who drive data & insights, and inform decision-making across every corner of our business. They are analytical powerhouses and first principles problem solvers who push forward our most important initiatives across product, growth, tech, and operations. Every business unit has a BizOps team member embedded within it — someone who doesn't just run analyses and build dashboards, but shapes what questions we should ask, what data to pull, what conclusions to draw, what decisions to make, and then drives our teams towards our next goal: go from 5M to 50M customers and become a $10B business in the next 4 years.
